berlin.label: Berlin
berlin.note: Berlin charges 7.5% of the net room rate. The old 21-night cap was removed from 1 January 2025, so a normal stay is taxable throughout.

munich.label: Munich
munich.note: Munich charges no bed tax. Bavaria banned local hotel taxes, and the Bavarian Constitutional Court upheld that ban in 2025, so the city cannot levy one.

frankfurt.label: Frankfurt
frankfurt.note: Frankfurt charges a flat 2 euros per person, per night, rather than a percentage.
